The Agent produced a three-replacement patch for one file. The executor validated each replacement against the original file and wrote each independently, so later writes overwrote earlier ones. The evidence recorder then crashed because it assumed modified-file entries were objects rather than strings.

The Flash navigator requested several valid files whose combined size exceeded the read budget. The tool rejected the whole request and incorrectly consumed exploration budget, causing repeated identical requests.

The first complete run repeatedly carried all prior source payloads. It used 475868 model tokens in 20 exploration turns and produced no patch. This violates the intended token-efficient Pro/Flash routing and is not comparable to the frozen protocol.
